scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q; else exec python3 -m pytest -q; fi'
scripts.dev: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else exec python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi'
scripts.start: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else exec python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi'
